companyOverview.name: LightsOn International
companyOverview.tagline: Illuminating Global Commerce. Protecting Generational Wealth.
companyOverview.missionStatement: To build, protect, and expand a portfolio of strategically aligned businesses across global markets through disciplined ownership, trust-centered governance, and long-term value creation.
companyOverview.visionStatement: To become a premier international holding and operating structure recognized for integrity, multi-generational prosperity, and transformative impact across industries and continents.
companyOverview.shortDescription: LightsOn International is an umbrella holding and operating structure designed to own, control, and grow multiple businesses domestically and internationally — built on a foundation of trust-centered ownership and dynastic wealth preservation.
companyOverview.longDescription: LightsOn International serves as the central umbrella holding and operating entity for a growing portfolio of business ventures across the United States and Latin America. Structured around a trust-centered ownership model, the organization is engineered for asset protection, operational control, and multi-generational wealth transfer. LightsOn International maintains a minimum 75% ownership stake in all controlled entities, ensuring centralized governance while enabling decentralized operations. The structure encompasses consulting, real estate, capital deployment, technology, and international commerce — all guided by a philosophy of building enterprises that endure.

legalAndOwnershipStructure.trustStructureSummary: The Light Trust is an irrevocable dynastic trust designed to hold ownership of LightsOn International across generations. It is structured to provide asset protection, prevent forced sale or fragmentation, and ensure continuity of control across succession events.
legalAndOwnershipStructure.controlModel: Centralized control through LightsOn International with a minimum 75% ownership requirement in all controlled entities
legalAndOwnershipStructure.ownershipPolicy: LightsOn International must own at least 75% of any entity classified as a controlled subsidiary or operating entity within the portfolio
legalAndOwnershipStructure.governanceNotes: Governance decisions flow from The Light Trust through LightsOn International to subsidiary entities. Each entity may have its own operational management but strategic authority is retained at the LightsOn International level.
legalAndOwnershipStructure.approvalAuthority: LightsOn International executive leadership, subject to trust instrument provisions
legalAndOwnershipStructure.votingControl: Maintained at LightsOn International level; minority partners have limited voting rights per operating agreements
legalAndOwnershipStructure.restrictionsOnTransfers: Ownership interests in controlled entities may not be transferred without approval of LightsOn International governing authority; trust instrument restricts alienation of top-level ownership
